svg.text: Per-window tables (SetWinColor / GetAuxWin, the "wctb" resource) may override these; only values 0–12 are accepted.
Built by AVERAGE_COLOR(c1, c2, ratio) = c1·ratio + c2·(1−ratio); the values below are for the default table above.
3 · Where they land on an active window (default table)

g.text: title bar: #FFFFFF when the window is inactive
close box and zoom box: framed, filled with content colour
bluish shadow band drawn under the title bar
the interior, and the window's RGB back colour
grow box, with dialog_dark · #000000 for the inner frame

svg.text: Used when the mixing step fails on the current device depth; red is the literal UNUSED sentinel {0xFFFF, 0, 0}.
Slot 0 is patched from the colour table at the end (line 193), so a window with a coloured background keeps it. Slots 2–9, 16 and 18 are never painted in the
B&W path; slot 13 is white and slot 11 is white, so monochrome windows show a plain white title bar and white tinge.
Rounded windows (wdef16) return before the averaging step, so slots 15–18 keep their static zero (black) values.
